answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit and pass a proof-of-personhood witness, then each epoch their signed work is compared across a random peer sample. If an identity's output is only an echo of another agent's submission, the duplicate is flagged. Any cluster of coordinated identities sitting on the same canyon of inactivity or sharing a ridge of identical metadata loses its stake, so fake accounts cost real capital per identity rather than free registration.
